#include <iostream>

using namespace std;

class InputReader {
public:
    istream& is;
    vector<char> buf;
    int pos;
    int size;

    InputReader(istream& is) : is(is), buf(1024), pos(0), size(0) {}

    int nextInt() {
        int c = read();
        while (isWhitespace(c))
            c = read();
        int sign = 1;
        if (c == '-') {
            sign = -1;
            c = read();
        }
        int res = 0;
        do {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9')
                throw runtime_error("Input mismatch");
            res = res * 10 + c - '0';
            c = read();
        } while (!isWhitespace(c));
        return res * sign;
    }

private:
    int read() {
        if (size == -1)
            throw runtime_error("Input mismatch");
        if (pos >= size) {
            pos = 0;
            size = is.readsome(&buf[0], buf.size());
            if (size <= 0)
                return -1;
        }
        return buf[pos++] & 255;
    }

    static bool isWhitespace(int c) {
        return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == -1;
    }
};

vector<int> multiplyMod(const vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b, int mod) {
    int need = a.size() + b.size() - 1;
    int n = max(2, 1 << (32 - __builtin_clz(need - 1)));

    vector<double> aReal(n, 0.0);
    vector<double> aImaginary(n, 0.0);
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)a.size(); i++) {
        int x = ((a[i] % mod) + mod) % mod;
        aReal[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1);
        aImaginary[i] = x >> 15;
    }
    fft(aReal, aImaginary, false);

    vector<double> bReal(n, 0.0);
    vector<double> bImaginary(n, 0.0);
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)b.size(); i++) {
        int x = ((b[i] % mod) + mod) % mod;
        bReal[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1);
        bImaginary[i] = x >> 15;
    }
    fft(bReal, bImaginary, false);

    vector<double> faReal(n, 0.0);
    vector<double> faImaginary(n, 0.0);
    vector<double> fbReal(n, 0.0);
    vector<double> fbImaginary(n, 0.0);

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int j = (n - i) & (n - 1);

        double a1r = (aReal[i] + aReal[j]) / 2;
        double a1i = (aImaginary[i] - aImaginary[j]) / 2;
        double a2r = (aImaginary[i] + aImaginary[j]) / 2;
        double a2i = (aReal[j] - aReal[i]) / 2;

        double b1r = (bReal[i] + bReal[j]) / 2;
        double b1i = (bImaginary[i] - bImaginary[j]) / 2;
        double b2r = (bImaginary[i] + bImaginary[j]) / 2;
        double b2i = (bReal[j] - bReal[i]) / 2;

        faReal[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
        faImaginary[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;

        fbReal[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i;
        fbImaginary[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r;
    }

    fft(faReal, faImaginary, true);
    fft(fbReal, fbImaginary, true);
    vector<int> res(need);
    for (int i = 0; i < need; i++) {
        long long aa = (long long)(faReal[i] + 0.5);
        long long bb = (long long)(fbReal[i] + 0.5);
        long long cc = (long long)(faImaginary[i] + 0.5);
        res[i] = (int)((aa + ((bb % mod) << 15) + ((cc % mod) << 30)) % mod);
    }
    return res;
}

void fft(vector<double>& a, vector<double>& b, bool inverse) {
    int n = a.size();
    int shift = 32 - __builtin_ctz(n);
    vector<int> rev(n, 0);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        rev[i] = (rev[i >> 1] >> 1) + ((i & 1) == 0 ? 0 : n / 2);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        int j = rev[i];
        if (i < j) {
            double temp = a[i];
            a[i] = a[j];
            a[j] = temp;
            temp = b[i];
            b[i] = b[j];
            b[j] = temp;
        }
    }
    for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
        int halfLen = len >> 1;
        vector<double> cs(halfLen);
        vector<double> sn(halfLen);
        for (int i = 0; i < halfLen; i++) {
            cs[i] = cos(2 * M_PI * i / len * (inverse ? -1 : 1));
            sn[i] = sin(2 * M_PI * i / len * (inverse ? -1 : 1));
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
            for (int j = 0; j < halfLen; j++) {
                double wA = cs[j];
                double wB = sn[j];
                double uA = a[i + j];
                double uB = b[i + j];
                double vA = a[i + j + halfLen] * wA - b[i + j + halfLen] * wB;
                double vB = a[i + j + halfLen] * wB + b[i + j + halfLen] * wA;
                a[i + j] = uA + vA;
                b[i + j] = uB + vB;
                a[i + j + halfLen] = uA - vA;
                b[i + j + halfLen] = uB - vB;
            }
        }
    }
    if (inverse) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] /= n;
            b[i] /= n;
        }
    }
}

void solve() {
    int mod = 998244353;
    int n, k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    vector<int> v(10, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        v[x] = 1;
    }
    vector<int> ans = {1};
    int p = n / 2;
    while (true) {
        if (p % 2 != 0) {
            ans = multiplyMod(ans, v, mod);
        }
        p /= 2;
        if (p == 0) break;
        v = multiplyMod(v, v, mod);
    }
    int res = 0;
    for (int x : ans) {
        res = (int)((res + (long long)x * x) % mod);
    }
    cout << res << endl;
}

int main() {
